Two markdown-only touched paths with no mapping triggered this fallback twice during a single implement dispatch (once per phase), each adding several minutes beyond the already-selected 23-suite run.

Do not attribute this suite's timeout to content/lint changes in a dispatch that only touched markdown/JSON; check known-failures.txt first rather than re-running it repeatedly.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh OWED fallback cost
sapience_notes.value: A touched path with no suite mapping triggers verify-touched.sh's OWED fallback, which runs run-all.sh's entire suite battery (98 suites observed in this repository) under a '--cost-class free' label, despite taking several minutes wall-clock. This happened twice in one implement dispatch because two markdown-only paths (a new context note plus an existing one) both lacked suite mappings.

sapience_notes.subject: Half-line test decision rule
sapience_notes.value: A proposed transport or index condition stated via the open modals is already decided if both the counter and the formula are read from the forward half-line: the frozen-future direction dies to Probe855O.cntAt_eq_of_pend_eq_fwd, and the freed-future direction dies to Probe761S.splice_type_invariance_refuted. This is now recorded as a durable lean4 context pattern note rather than something that must be rediscovered per proposal.

sapience_notes.subject: Two six-mechanism sets do not coincide
sapience_notes.value: The lean4 context note domain/ladder-counter-observables.md's six mechanisms defeating a clipped-coordinate index, and the half-line test's own six probe citations (from the originating report's mechanism-by-mechanism table), overlap in only 4 of 6 files and neither is a subset of the other. The plan's own Risk table estimated a 'three'-file overlap; direct measurement found four. Neither deliverable transcribes either table or its count, only the fact that they differ.

sapience_notes.subject: git-commit-phase.sh Containment Self-Check drop-and-propose mechanics
sapience_notes.value: When a whole-tree redeploy (deploy-headless.sh) incidentally modifies a repo-root tracked file not in a task's declared file_scope (.claude-extensions.json, regenerated with a timestamp/content refresh), git-commit-phase.sh's Containment Self-Check drops it from the phase commit, emits a WARNING, and deposits the path into .return-meta.json's proposed_file_scope array. A scoped follow-up commit via git-commit-scoped.sh directly (never a second git-commit-phase.sh call for the same path, which would re-hit the same unwidened file_scope and drop it again) is the correct remedy.
